conventions.coefficient: A is the beat RESPONSE coefficient in b_raw=noise+A*h; fixed, not fitted here
conventions.time: Raw Beijing timestamps minus UTC_OFFSET (8 hours) yield UTC
conventions.bounds: First and last actual retained sample timestamps, after BOTH endpoint trims
conventions.dff: mean_dff=mean(h)/F_1550 is tidal deltaW/c^2, NOT exact ratio normalization

formulas.correction: b_corr=b_raw-A*h (negative A adds the undemeaned template)
formulas.fractional: R0=RAW segment ratio for every scenario; e=(b-raw_float_mean)-float(A)*h; q=float(K/S0)*e; y=-q/(1+q)

processing.selection: Unchanged shared loaders, inclusive exclusions, global plausible median; group [start,end), 30MHz<b<40MHz, abs(b-group_median)<10Hz; longest_valid_span then raw endpoint_screen; never re-screen corrections
processing.interpolation: Finite sorted unique UTC 30s grid; linear interpolation; no clamping, extrapolation or bridging missing >30s intervals
processing.stability: Break at every non-1s timestamp step, including duplicates; pool squared differences/counts within each segment only
processing.taus: Per segment: dyadic seconds plus 600,1200,3600,7200, capped at one quarter of its longest continuous raw run; identical grid across scenarios
processing.centering: Numerical centering only before prefix sums; no detrending or tide demeaning
processing.std: Sample fractional and beat standard deviations, ddof=1; CSV empty if n<2
processing.n_pairs: Overlapping pair count, not independent degrees of freedom
processing.zero_sigma: Corrected/raw OADEV factor is empty when raw sigma is zero or unavailable; unavailable OADEV is empty, never NaN

limitations: Conditional comparison for fixed exact Decimal A=-1 and A=-0.54, not coefficient estimates.
No coefficient, tide-model or systematic uncertainty is propagated.
Raw baseline intentionally inherits the legacy float64 raw mean (converted via repr), then Decimal80 arithmetic; raw quantization is not recovered.
Segment ratio is inversion after averaging corrected linear beat, not the mean of instantaneous ratios.
OADEV and sample std are not SEM; no WLS uncertainty or significance claim is manufactured.
